text:
Arin Cole: dropping a quick pass on the fidelity flyout for the latency card — Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/latency/fidelity-flyout :mag:
Samira Voss: nice work. main issue: when narrow, p95 and p99 chips squeeze into the scrubber zone and text truncates
Diego Ramos: can we collapse percentiles into a single 'Percentiles' flyout that lists toggles? keeps header clean.
Mina Park: yep — but the collapsed control must still expose selections to screen readers. Use aria-label like 'Percentiles: p50, p95' on the button.
Arin Cole: agreed. also reword sampling control — current 'Show samples' unclear. proposal: 'Sampling fidelity' with options 'Auto (recommended) | High | Economy'.
Samira Voss: +1. add short helper text under the control: 'Auto balances accuracy and cost.' That should reduce confusion.
Diego Ramos: heatmap rendering note: low-fidelity mode creates pixelated gaps users think are missing data. Suggest a stipple overlay for low-sample buckets and a small legend pill 'stippled = low sample density'.
Mina Park: love 'stippled'. accessibility: expose the legend to screen readers and surface 'Stippled buckets indicate low sample density; results may be noisy.' as aria-describedby for the heatmap.
A11y Bot: Snapshot saved for 1728888888 — will include alt text and legend ids.
Samira Voss: keyboard flow bug: open range picker, tab through presets -> calendars -> fidelity control -> Apply. Expected Apply before fidelity control. Focus order needs to be linear.
Arin Cole: logged UX-9987: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/UX-9987 for popover focus order fix. interim patch: set tabindex on Apply to force it before the fidelity control.
Diego Ramos: small CSS pattern for collapsed percentile button (semantic-first):

<button aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Percentiles: p50, p95">...</button>

no visually-hidden hacks; tooltip shows numeric values on hover/tap.
Mina Park: final decisions: 1) Replace 'Show samples' with 'Sampling fidelity' and helper text 'Auto balances accuracy and cost'. 2) Collapse percentiles into a flyout with aria-label exposing selections. 3) Add stipple overlay + legend for low-density heatmap buckets and expose via aria-describedby. 4) Fix focus order in range popover (UX-9987). I'll update the mock and hand off to Eng tomorrow morning :rocket:
